2.shot_en: Dutch-angle low cutaway: crows on a charred fence rail in razor focus, all turning their heads south at once; horses blurred in the background.

6.shot_en: Straight-down overhead top view of the burned village square: the refugee line streams out of frame while a kneeling Elara triages wounded on linen, ash on the stones.

8.shot_en: Low-angle close-up of Elara's face, ash-smudged, jaw set, eyes hard; razor-thin focus on her eyes, background refugees melting into bokeh.

11.shot_en: Drone shot rising and pulling back: Elara and the little girl tiny in the empty square while the refugee line recedes into the ash haze; vast negative space.

16.shot_en: Overhead top-view insert into Elara's apron pocket: a torn scrap of midnight-blue cloth with a silver wolf in a chain collar, among bandage rolls.

18.shot_en: Low-angle three-quarter close-up of Elara speaking quietly, candle key on one side, black negative fill on the other, half her face in shadow.

23.shot_en: Dutch-angle low medium shot: Elara shields the girl behind her back, small medical knife raised toward off-frame intruders, the wounded soldier on the pew beside them, hard rim light from the doorway.

27.shot_en: Low-angle medium close-up of Torval, hand on his sword hilt, looking toward his commander with grim meaning; soldiers out of focus behind, cold rim light.

28.shot_en: Elara's POV: Riven in close-up through her shallow focus, silent, his eyes lowering to her hands; foreground blur of her own raised knife edge.

32.shot_en: Extreme close-up of Elara's eye through a gap in burning debris, sparks reflected in the iris.

33.shot_en: Straight-down overhead top view inside the ruined chapel: everyone frozen mid-motion — soldiers, Elara, Riven, the little girl — ash particles hanging suspended in the air like stopped time.

40.shot_en: Drone long shot slowly orbiting behind a figure in an ash-grey hooded cloak standing on the hilltop, the smoking chapel far below; vast negative space.
